'''Unconscious''' [[File:status_unconscious_icon.png]] is the state wherein a [[creature]] is unable to move, act, or perceive sight or sound. It is noted as {{DFtext|'''Unconscious'''|7:1}} in the {{DFtext|Overview|7:1}} screen of a selected creature, but does ''not'' appear as a [[wound|health problem]] in the {{DFtext|Health|7:1}} -> {{DFtext|Status|7:1}} screen.

Creatures that are [[sleep]]ing are unconscious, though being unconscious is different from performing the [[rest]] action as dwarves that are unconscious will not heal from their injuries. [[Syndrome]]s can also cause periodic unconsciousness as one of their symptoms, and creatures caught in the dust of a [[cave-in]] are momentarily knocked unconscious.

Creatures may fall unconscious during [[combat]], most often due to the extreme [[symptom#pain|pain]] of sustained injuries whereupon the creature {{DFtext|'''gives in to pain.'''|6:0}} Attacks that damage a creature's bones are highly likely to cause it to fall unconscious in this way due to the high amount of pain that [[Wound|bone fractures]] cause. The amount of pain required to knock out a creature is based on its [[attribute#toughness|toughness]] [[attribute]].

Any unconscious creature can be caught in a [[trap]], including creatures that are normally [[trapavoid|immune]] to them. This includes the player's own dwarves in [[fortress mode]], who might decide to take a nap they won't wake up from on a tile with 10 [[Trap_component|giant axe blade]]s.

If a dwarf is stuck in a state of endless unconsciousness, they can still be awoken by [[emigration|expelling]] them.{{verify}}
